description_en: Removes the hosts and host accounts authorized for a user group
description_zh: 移除给用户组授权的主机及主机账户
name: DetachHostAccountsFromUserGroup

parameters.help_en:
Specifies the instance ID of the Bastionhost instance that manages the user group for which you want to remove the authorization of hosts and host accounts.
You can invoke the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to obtain the value of this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
指定要移除授权主机和主机账户的用户组所在堡垒机的实例ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies the region ID of the Bastionhost instance that manages the user group from which you want to remove authorized hosts and host accounts.
For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
指定要移除授权主机和主机账户的用户组所在堡垒机的区域ID。
区域ID和区域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies the ID of the user group from which you want to remove authorized hosts and host accounts.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/204509.html operation to obtain the value of this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
指定要移除授权主机和主机账户的用户组ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/204509.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: user_group_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies the IDs of the hosts and host accounts whose authorization you want to remove from the user group.  
You can specify up to 10 host IDs, and up to 10 host account IDs for each host. You can leave the host account IDs empty. If you do not specify host account IDs, the host and all its authorized host accounts are removed from the user group. For more information about the structure of this parameter, see the Hosts parameter structure description in the request parameters section.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/200665.html operation to obtain host IDs and call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/204372.html operation to obtain host account IDs
parameters.help_zh:
指定要为用户组移除授权的主机ID和主机账户ID。  
最多支持设置10个主机ID，每个主机最多支持设置10个主机账户ID。您可以不设置主机账户ID，不设置主机账户ID表示为用户组移除授权主机和该主机的所有授权主机账户。该参数的具体结构请参考请求参数列表下的Hosts参数结构说明。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/200665.html接口获取主机ID，调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/204372.html接口获取主机账户ID
parameters.name: hosts
